senses.gloss:
दभ्, दंभ् I. {c1c} {c5c} P. (दभति or
दभ्नोति, दब्ध; desid. धिप्सति, धीप्सति,
दिदंभिषति)
1 To injure, hurt.
--2 To
deceive, cheat.
--3 To go. -II.
{c10c} U. (दंभयति-ते) To impel, propel,
drive onward.

दभ्र a. Little, small;
अदभ्रदर्भामधिशय्य स स्थलीं Ki. 1. 38; see अदभ्र.
--भ्रः The ocean.
--भ्रं ind. A little,
slightly, to some extent.
